answer: A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The river counter is kept in violet and spiral shows each reset. Anyone thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3042 identities would post 2625 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
